title: Failed Notification Delivery Count
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=notify_failed
| stats count as failures by target platform
| sort - failures
description: Summarises failed push, text, or speaker notifications so the messages your automations depend on do not silently disappear.
value: An alerting system that cannot deliver is worse than none at all because it creates false confidence; this keeps the last mile visible.
implementation: Forward notification failure events from your automation platform; review the failure leaderboard weekly and repair the noisiest channel first.
visualization: Table of notification targets by delivery failure count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares when the messages your smart home tries to send you are failing to get through.
